controls.note: One approved preview branch, synthetic client only, production branch 404, dedicated synthetic D1 only and no R2 binding.
Same-origin URL-encoded form posts, streamed 4096-byte limit, exact fields and fail-closed methods.
Random one-hour scoped sessions are hash-stored in synthetic D1 and checked against invitation, account and grant state on every request; logout, recovery and revocation invalidate them immediately.
Synthetic-only projection with a dedicated preview database; no real-client or production storage, uploads or public booking route.
Requires approved identity/recovery service, adult-authority workflow and multi-account object authorization implementation.
Requires Founder and qualified review of data location, subprocessors, transfers, retention, export, deletion and AI use.
Requires approved private storage/scanning services and a rehearsed incident process with named human ownership.
